svg.title: InfoMentor MCP server architecture
svg.desc: A generic MCP host connects over standard input and output to the InfoMentor MCP server. The server exposes eight default tools, five opt-in advanced tools, and four opt-in setup tools, uses protected local credentials and session state, and communicates directly with InfoMentor HTTPS endpoints. Explicit fritidsschema writes are read back before success is reported.

g.text: compatible desktop, CLI, or agent host
list tools • call tools • receive results
supplies private env or file paths
no provider credentials in MCP arguments
process lifecycle • protocol handshake • tool registration
host-neutral: no specific client or orchestration platform required
no browser automation or remote relay
provider responses are validated before return
never in tool arguments, logs, or repository
specific host is chosen by the user
no messages sent or notifications marked read
